overlayEntry.notes: Reviewed 2026-07-27 (supersedes the 2026-07-20 review with a fresh measurement and new backstop evidence). The Parallelizer Module documentation establishes a basket conversion mechanism rather than a debt CDP: USDp is minted and burnt at oracle value against a DAO-whitelisted asset set with adaptive fees that widen as an asset depegs or exposures breach target bounds, and any holder can redeem at any time for a proportional share of the backing basket, with a dynamic penalty factor applied when the system collateral ratio falls below 100% so redemptions re-collateralize the system. The mechanism therefore has no borrower debt positions and no liquidation engine; liquidationMechanics and the liquidation capacity metric are structurally not applicable. MEASURED 2026-07-27 ~22:52 UTC: Parallel's server-rendered transparency inventory publishes per-asset reserve values summing to 2,055,279.68 USD (Ethereum: frxUSD 251,516.15, sfrxUSD 478,747.92, USDe 48.45, sUSDe 104,949.32; HyperEVM: sUSDe 522,175.30, USDeOFT 28,695.76; Base: sUSDS 77,515.19, USDS 21.61, USDC 4.00; Avalanche: ygamiUSDC 576,451.58, USDC 15,154.39) against a published total USDp supply of 1,976,343.74, a backing ratio of 1.039940 (down from 1.040064 on 2026-07-20). The reported collateralization ratio is an observed issuer-dashboard measurement, not a vault TCR. External anchors this review: (1) pinned eth_call totalSupply reads across all eight deployment chains (Ethereum 25627275, Base 49201858, Avalanche 91391171, HyperEVM 41619438, Arbitrum 488406161, Optimism 154797144, Sonic 76609019, Sei 222617726) sum to 1,976,338.49 USDp, within 5.3 of the dashboard figure; (2) the Ethereum Parallelizer diamond at block 25627275 returned getCollateralList = [frxUSD, sfrxUSD, USDe, sUSDe] (matching the dashboard's Ethereum basket) and getCollateralRatio = 1.007832280 with 828,660.97 stablecoins issued tracked by the instance, implying ~835,151 USD of Ethereum-instance collateral versus the dashboard's 835,261.85 Ethereum reserve figure (0.013% apart, oracle-timing noise). The whitelisted basket, per-asset exposure targets, and adaptive fee schedule are documented and on-chain verified, supporting adequate collateralization parameters. Permissionless anytime proportional redemption at oracle value supports adequate structural redemption, subject to the documented whitelist caveat for restricted collateral assets. The documented below-100% redemption penalty is a socialized, fee-based recapitalization path rather than an insurance fund, and pause/guardian powers sit with DAO governance and a team multisig, supporting limited shutdownAndBadDebt. NEW backstop evidence: the Parallel Insurance Fund (ratified MIP-28, updated PGP-31) is documented with itemized assets (vlAURA 1,113,709.10, Aura-ECLP PAR/paUSD LP positions, VaultsCore minimums of 10,000 PAR and 1,000 paUSD per V2 chain) and named per-chain multisigs; the DAO has approved covering Parallel V3 USDp deployments on Ethereum, Base, Sonic, HyperEVM, and Avalanche up to 100% of the fund via the bug bounty program. The Ethereum fund multisig 0x6aF71a3723D3c0Ed69f84EE259c9De3019C2a77c was verified on-chain at block 25627275 holding 17,855.61 USDC and 0.0936 WETH. This is issuer-published structured data with an on-chain anchor, supporting limited backstop — not adequate, because coverage is discretionary (DAO-multisig administered and routed through the bug bounty program rather than contractually automatic into the Parallelizer), largely legacy-token-denominated, the verified liquid stable float is small relative to the ~2.06M USD backing, and the vlAURA/LP itemization was not independently verified in this review. NOT established: the isolation between per-chain Parallelizer baskets sharing one fungible USDp — the Proof of Solvency page documents that each chain's Parallelizer holds its own backing, but no loss-isolation or cross-chain rebalancing mechanism is documented, so branchIsolation remains bounded-unknown; and the freshness bounds or failover behavior of the underlying Chainlink/RedStone/DIA feeds, which are scored under oracle risk.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: USDp is minted, burnt, and redeemed at oracle value through the Parallelizer conversion module; there are no debt positions and no liquidation engine, so no capital pool is contractually committed to debt-offset liquidation.

liquidationMechanics.rationale: The Parallelizer is a mint/burn/redeem conversion module at oracle value; USDp holders hold no debt positions and depeg risk is handled by adaptive fees and proportional redemption rather than liquidation.

evidenceSummary: Re-measured the USDp backing 2026-07-27T22:52Z from Parallel's server-rendered transparency inventory: reserves 2,055,279.68 USD across 11 asset rows on 4 chains (largest: HyperEVM sUSDe 522,175.30; Ethereum sfrxUSD 478,747.92; Avalanche ygamiUSDC 576,451.58) against total supply 1,976,343.74, a collateralization ratio of 1.039940 (prior 1.040064). Corroborated on-chain: pinned totalSupply reads on all 8 deployment chains sum to 1,976,338.49 (within 5.3), and the Ethereum Parallelizer diamond at block 25627275 returned getCollateralRatio 1.007832280 with 828,660.97 issued (implied Ethereum collateral 835,151 vs dashboard 835,262) and a collateral list matching the dashboard basket. New backstop evidence: the documented Parallel Insurance Fund (MIP-28/PGP-31) covers V3 USDp deployments up to 100% of the fund via the bug bounty program, with itemized assets and named multisigs; the Ethereum fund multisig 0x6aF71a3723D3c0Ed69f84EE259c9De3019C2a77c verified at block 25627275 holding 17,855.61 USDC + 0.0936 WETH. Graded: collateralizationParameters adequate (documented basket/targets/fees + on-chain verified list), structuralRedemption adequate (anytime proportional redemption), shutdownAndBadDebt limited (socialized penalty recapitalization; guardian pause with DAO/multisig), backstop limited (NEW — documented, itemized, on-chain-anchored fund but discretionary, bug-bounty-routed, legacy-token-heavy, small verified liquid float; vlAURA/LP itemization unverified). branchIsolation left bounded: per-chain backing documented by Proof of Solvency, but no loss-isolation mechanism is documented.
